description.zh: 寫一個程式，讀入三個整數（各佔一行），輸出它們的和。
description.en: Write a program that takes three numbers and prints their sum. Every number is given on a separate line.

hint.zh: 使用 cin >> a >> b >> c; 讀取三個整數，相加後用 cout 輸出。
hint.en: Read three integers with cin >> a >> b >> c;, add them, and print the sum with cout.
